label: Extrude
help: Choose a sketch. The distance is taken from the scan and can be dragged at the arrow or typed. With To plane the extrusion ends at a plane. Options decide whether a new body is created or an existing body is changed.
noSketch: No sketch yet. Create a sketch first.
lengthMissing: The distance must be greater than 0.

problems.targetUnknown: The target body no longer exists. Choose another body.
problems.targetIsTool: The target body cannot also be a tool.
problems.toolsMissing: Choose at least one tool body.
